headline: Orderly Nasdaq premarket setup as yields ease and oil stress persists
body: Global bond yields have eased after expanded U.S. Treasury buybacks and risk sentiment has improved, while Brent near three-week highs and constrained Strait of Hormuz shipping keep cross-asset Stress elevated. Fresh supplementary semiconductor context is constructive, but no independent evidence confirms persistent NQ extension or repeated failed retracements.
